note: The status strip left of the hotbar (Dave 23 Nov 2026: symbols in a row, no borders, the same height as the hotbar; food and water with their percentage once they run low; a symbol for every state that changes the player). src/client/status_icons.gd draws it; scenes/terrain_client/terrain_client.gd _setup_status_strip holds each symbol's read. One row per symbol, left to right (the last sits next to the hotbar): id; name (said above it for a few seconds when it appears); glyph (art_kit.gd glyph_shapes); line, or lines by tone (0 plain, 1 warning, 2 danger), the hover words with {words} from the read; always (shown from the start, no name note); show_below (food and water: shown only under this percent, Dave 24 Nov 2026); opacity; warn_at and danger_at, where the strip itself picks when a number turns amber or red (display only: the game's own limits, such as vitals.json warn_hunger, stay in their files). A new effect (a spell, a potion) is a row here and a read there. The numbers in the words come from the game's own data files through the read, never typed here.

symbols.name: Inspecting
symbols.line: Inspection mode: looking at something names it. Press the inspect key again to stop.

symbols.name: Pulling a cart
symbols.line: Pulling a handcart: you go no faster than the cart, {n} m/s. Let go of it to walk freely.

symbols.name: Snow underfoot
symbols.line: Snow underfoot: you walk at {n}% of your normal speed and tire faster. Snowshoes help.

symbols.name: Under cover
symbols.line: Under cover: rain does not reach you here, and wet clothes slowly dry.

lines.0: Soaked: wet clothes keep less of their warmth, so the cold bites harder. They dry only under a roof or a tree, or quickly by a fire.
lines.1: Soaked in the wind: the wind cuts through your wet clothes and you cool fast. Get under a roof or to a fire.

lines.0: Cold: you shiver, so you tire faster, and your health stops coming back. Warm up by a fire, under a roof or in warmer clothes.
lines.1: Freezing: the cold is costing you health and your work is slower. Get to a fire.
lines.2: Dangerously cold: you have stopped shivering, you lose health fast and work very slowly. Get to a fire now.

symbols.name: Sick
symbols.line: Sick: you tire as if working hard, and now and then you lose food and water. About {h} game hours left; sleep or medicine shortens it.

lines.1: Tired: energy {n}%. At 0 you fall asleep where you stand. Sit, lie down or sleep to get it back.
lines.2: Exhausted: energy {n}%. You are about to fall asleep where you stand. Rest now.

symbols.name: Over-exerted
symbols.line: Over-exerted: you move {n}% slower. Walk or rest to get your breath back; keep pushing and you pass out.

lines.1: Heavy load: {p}% of what you can carry ({kg} of {cap} kg). Past {free} kg it slows you; you move at {n}% of your normal speed. Put something down or store it.
lines.2: Too heavy: {p}% of what you can carry ({kg} of {cap} kg). You move at {n}% of your normal speed. Put something down.

symbols.name: Injured leg
symbols.line: Injured leg: you walk at {n}% of your normal speed. A splint fixes it; otherwise it heals by itself within {min} minutes, sooner once your health is back to {heal}.

lines.0: Air: {n} seconds of breath left under water. Surface to breathe.
lines.2: Out of air soon: {n} seconds left. Surface now.

lines.0: Health {n} of {max}. It comes back slowly while you have food, water and warmth.
lines.1: Badly hurt: health {n} of {max}. It comes back slowly while you have food, water and warmth.
lines.2: Close to collapse: health {n} of {max}. Rest by a fire with food and water.

symbols.name: Comfort
symbols.line: Comfort, 0 to 10: the campfire warms with the level, and a small arrow shows it rising or falling. Shelter, a fire and furniture nearby raise it.

lines.1: Food {n}%: you are low on food. Eat soon.
lines.2: Starving: your health stops coming back and your body weight falls. Eat something.

lines.1: Water {n}%: you are low on water. Drink fresh water soon.
lines.2: Parched: your health stops coming back. Drink fresh water.
